"''So? That's what pirates do.|Drusil Bephorin and Luke Skywalker|}} '''Exodeen''' was a [[planet]] in the [[Colonies]]' [[Exodeen system]], situated along the [[Hydian Way]] and [[Nanth'ri Trade Route]]. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] operative [[Luke Skywalker]] traveled, aboard the yacht ''[[Desert Jewel]]'', to Exodeen from the planet [[Denon]] to take the Nanth'ri Trade Route on his way to the planet Omereth. [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[starship]]s were present in Exodeen's [[Star system|system]] when the ''Jewel'' arrived, prompting its swift departure for the celestial body [[Nanth'ri]]. ==Description== {{Quote|We would have to keep going toward the planet, let the Imperials spot us, and then see if they chase us.|Skywalker, to Nakari Kelen|}} Exodeen was a [[planet]] in the [[Colonies]]' [[Exodeen system]], situated at the coordinates M-12 on the [[Standard Galactic Grid]]. It was along the [[Hydian Way]] [[super-hyperroute]],{{BuildFalconCite|48|Guide to the Galaxy}} between the celestial bodies [[Bellassa]][[Star Wars: The Force Awakens Beginner Game|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Beginner Game]] and [[Suntilla]], and was the eastern endpoint of the [[Nanth'ri Trade Route]] which connected it to the astronomical object [[Caragon-Viner]].''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'' ==History== {{Quote|They're going to know we're here soon because we can't conceal the reflected light of our entry, but if we leave now we can prevent them from getting a deep scan and confirming three life-forms aboard—assuming that her decryption is true and they're looking for us.|Kelen, to Skywalker|}} In [[0 ABY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[Heir to the Jedi]]'' to [[0 ABY]]. the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] operatives [[Luke Skywalker]] and [[Nakari Kelen]] [[Mission on Denon|extracted]] the [[givin]] [[cryptologist]] [[Drusil Bephorin]] from the custody of the [[Galactic Empire]] on the [[Inner Rim Territories]] planet [[Denon]], planning on reuniting the givin with her family on the [[Outer Rim Territories]] planet [[Omereth]]. To get to Omereth, Skywalker, flying the yacht ''[[Desert Jewel]]'', planned to take the Hydian Way from Denon to Exodeen, and then continue on the Nanth'ri Trade Route to the celestial body [[Nanth'ri]]. However, several Imperial [[starship]]s, including a [[Star Destroyer]] and [[heavy cruiser]], were present in Exodeen's [[Star system|system]] when Skywalker's ship arrived, with word spreading over the [[HoloNet]] communications system about the fugitives. Skywalker quickly had his [[droid]] [[R2-D2]] set a course for Nanth'ri and the ''Jewel'' fled the Exodeen system. ==Behind the scenes== Exodeen first appeared in [[Kevin Hearne]]'s [[2014]] novel ''[[Heir to the Jedi]]''. ==Appearances== *''[[Star Wars Outlaws: Low Red Moon]]'' {{Mo}} *''[[Heir to the Jedi]]'' {{Ab|Heir to the Jedi (audiobook)}} {{1st}} *{{SkeletonCrew|Very Interesting, As an Astrogation Problem}} {{C|Mentioned in [[Aurebesh]] on [[computer]] screen}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=news/where-in-the-galaxy-are-the-worlds-of-star-wars-the-force-awakens|text=Where in the Galaxy Are the Worlds of ''Star Wars: The Force Awakens''?|int=Where in the Galaxy Are the Worlds of Star Wars: The Force Awakens?}} {{MapPoint}} *[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens Beginner Game|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Beginner Game]] {{MapPoint}} *{{GalaxyMapPoster}} {{MapPoint}} *''[[Star Wars: Complete Locations, New Edition]]'' {{MapPoint}} *''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'' {{MapPoint}} *{{StarWarsGalaxyMap}} {{MapPoint}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Exodeen |fr=Exodeen |ja=エクソディーン |ka=ექსოდინი |pl=Exodeen |tr=Exodeen }} [[Category:Astronomical objects in the Colonies]] [[Category:Astronomical objects in the Slice]] [[Category:Locations along the Hydian Way]] [[Category:Locations along the Nanth'ri Trade Route]]
